system.description:
A small black disc or ring containing a kinetic battery, often with an illuminated rim, intended to transfer the charge of its own battery into another kinetic battery, reducing the time until the item is fully charged.

An Inductive Charger is a powered item which recharges after a Bed rest, but it doesn’t do anything unless it is discharged. When discharged, it recharges a Powered (Breather) item as if the item had received a Breather rest. A Powered (Break) item will recharge during the next Breather. A Powered (Bed) item will recharge during the next Break.
